answer: Operator-Linked Liability Ledger. Each agent action emits a signed signal tied to its provisioning operator; correlated action bursts form a spiral of shared risk that raises that operator's collateral requirement. When collusion is detected, the operator's entire identity plume is frozen and slashed, not individual wallets. Attacker cost scales with operators, not keys: spinning up N sybils under one operator exposes the full collateral, so cheap wallets no longer help.
